entries.toelichting: From √bachar (be-first); right and prerogative of firstborn (Esau, Reuben); the hyphenated English marks juridical status.
Prophet-seeks-vainly-early-fig; Mic 7:1.
Proper noun, ancestor of Saul; 1Sam 9:1; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Bekorath.
From √bachah (cry); loud tears as expression of grief; concordantly 'weeping'.
Proper noun ('weepers') where the angel rebuked the people; Judg 2:5; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Bochim.
Eldest-daughter specifically female (Gen 19:31,33,34,37; 29:26; 1Sam 14:49). Hyphenated to distinguish female-firstborn from H1060 bekor 'firstborn' (male-generic).
Period-of-weeping around Joseph; Gen 50:4.
Firstling-right give or early-fruits (Lev 27:26; Deut 21:16; Eze 47:12; Job 15:32). Hyphenated to distinguish the firstborn-aspect from H3205 yalad 'bear' and H7069 qanah 'acquire'.
Hapax Isa 60:6 young-male-camel/dromedary; root √bkr firstborn.
Benjamin's son and Ephraimite family-name (Gen 46:21; Num 26:35; 1Chr 7:6,8). 'Young-camel'. English convention: Becher.
People-as-young-camel-mare zigzagging; Jer 2:23.
Two-fig-baskets good-as early-ripe-figs; Jer 24:2.
1Chr-Azel-now-had-six-sons-and-these-are-their-names-Azrikam-Bochru-and-Ishmael-and-Sheariah-and-Obadiah-and-Hanan and 1Chr-id-Bochru-2 (1Chr 8:38; 9:44 par). Hyphenated.
Aramean city on the northern border (2Sam 20:14,15; 1Kgs 15:20; 2Kgs 15:29). English convention: Beth-Maacah.
Patronym-clan son of Ephraim; Num 26:35; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Bachrite.
Poetic negation-particle; synonym with lo; concordantly 'not' (same negation).
Bel-Babylon's-chief-god-is-put-to-shame and Bel-bows-down-Nebo-stoops and Bel-falls-over-Jeremiah (Isa 46:1; Jer 50:2; 51:44). English convention: Bel. Babylonian-chief-god-equivalent-Baal.
Aramaic parallel to bal; king-set-heart on rescue-Daniel; Dan 6:14.
Aramaic Pael; little-horn-shall-wear-out-saints; Dan 7:25.
2K-at-that-time-Berodach-Baladan-the-son-of-Baladan-king-of-Babylon-sent-letters-and-a-present-to-Hezekiah and Isa-id (2K 20:12; Isa 39:1).
Reviving-brightening at distress and turning-anger-away (Job 9:27; 10:20; Amos 5:9; Ps 39:14). Hyphenated to distinguish the brighten-revive-aspect from H2896 tov 'be-good' and H8055 samach.
Bilgah-fifteenth-priestly-division-David and Bilgah-priest-family-returnee (1Chr 24:14; Neh 12:5,18). English convention: Bilgah. 'Refreshment-cheerfulness' (family with balag 'brighten').
Proper noun, priestly signatory of covenant Nehemiah; Neh 10:8; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Bilgai.
Second friend of Job from Shuah (Job 2:11; 8:1; 18:1; 25:1; 42:9). English convention: Bildad. 'Lord-of-Adad'.
Qal/Piel: wear away, grow old (clothes, generations), cause to age (God makes enemies pass away); concordantly 'wear-out'.
Old worn-out sacks or clothes (Josh 9:4,5; Jer 38:11,12; Eze 23:43). Hyphenated to preserve the worn-out-aspect; family with H1086 balah.
Proper noun, Simeon-city; Josh 19:3; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Balah.
Hapax Ezra 4:4 land-people-hands-Judah-weaken; root √blh-II uncertain.

Rachel's-handmaid given as concubine to Jacob, mother of Dan and Naphtali (Gen 29:29 Laban's-gift, 30:3-7 two sons through her bear-on-Rachel's-knees, 35:22 Reuben's-incest-with-her, 35:25, 37:2 Joseph).
Second-sense Bilhah as place; Simeon-city; 1Chr 4:29; concordantly transliterated.

Abstract-noun for-sudden-terror-with-destruction distinguished from H4288 mechittah (terror) by total-destruction-aspect (Job 18:11,14 Bildad-on-the-wicked, 24:17, 27:20, 30:15, Isa 17:14, Jer 51:55, Eze 26:21, 27:36).
Horite-descendant and Benjamite (Gen 36:27; 1Chr 1:42; 7:10). English convention: Bilhan. 'Their-admiration'.
Aramaic-Persian loanword for tax; Ezra 7:24.
Jer-under-your-armpits-between-cords-worn-rags-Jeremiah-pulled-out-of-pit (Jer 38:11,12 twice). Hyphenated to distinguish the rags-worn-piece-aspect from H5499 sechavah-tatter.
Proper noun Belteshazzar, court-name of Daniel (Akkadian Balatsu-usur 'protect his life') - in Daniel 1:7 (the chief of the eunuchs gave them names; Daniel he called Belteshazzar) and Daniel 10:1.
Daniel's Babylonian court-name, in honour of Baal-protector (Dan 1:7; 2:26; 4:5,6,15,16; 5:12; 10:1). English convention: Belteshazzar. Concordantly via '-aramaic'.
Negation-particle: without, not; concordantly 'without' (distinguished from lo/ayin).
Job-wild-ass-mixed-fodder and Job-ox-at-his-feed-trough-mixture and Isa-grain-mixed-fodder (Job 6:5; 24:6; Isa 30:24). Hyphenated.
God hangs the earth on-nothing; Job 26:7.
Compound form (beli + yaal) 'without profit'; lawlessness, in NT 'Belial'; concordantly 'worthlessness'.
Qal: stir together (flour with oil, languages); concordantly 'mix'.
Hapax Judg 19:21 donkeys-feed-mixed; sub-sense pair with H1101a mix.
Hapax Ps 32:9 horse-harness-restrain; cognate H5716 adi ornament.
Qal-participle; Amos-fig-nicker-worker; Amos 7:14.
Qal: gulp down/engulf; distinguished from bala II (communicate); concordantly 'swallow-up'.

Swallowing or engulfing as action - in Psalm 52:6 (you love all devouring words, O deceitful tongue) and Jeremiah 51:44 (I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he has swallowed up); abstract noun.
Proper noun; older name of Zoar, and king in Edom, and Benjamite; concordantly transliterated (distinguished from bela 'swallowing').
Gen-Bera-king-Sodom-Birsha-king-Gomorrah-Shinab-king-Admah-Shemeber-king-Zeboiim-Bela-king-the-same-is-Zoar and Gen-same-coalition-repetition (Gen 14:2,8). Hyphenated.
Separating preposition: without, except; concordantly 'besides'.
Patronym-clan son of Benjamin; Num 26:38; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Belaite.
Proper noun (probably 'not-people' or 'devourer'); prophet of Beor; concordantly transliterated.
Second-sense Bileam as place; Levi-city of Manasseh; 1Chr 6:70; concordantly transliterated.

Lay waste and empty - in Isaiah 24:1 (the LORD makes the earth empty and makes it waste, and turns it upside down) and Nahum 2:11 (the city is empty and laid waste); reduplication-formula baqaq bilqah.
Proper noun; king of Moab; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, Babylonian king; Dan 8:1; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Belshazzar.
Persian loanword 'treasurer/keeper-of-funds' in Daniel (Dan 3:2,3). Hyphenated to preserve the official-function; concordantly via '-aramaic'.
One of the twelve leaders who returned with Zerubbabel from Babel - Ezra 2:2, Nehemiah 7:7.
Negative particle, specifically with infinitive-constructions. 'Not-' with hyphen preserves the prefixal function; distinguished from lo (H3808) and al (H408).
Unique lexeme. Elevation, hilltop, cultic high-place. 'High-place' covers the physical and cultic meaning.
Proper noun-question 'what is-that-high-place' wordplay-bamah; Eze 20:29; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, Asher tribe-head son of Japhlet; 1Chr 7:33; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Bimhal.
Poetic-archaic length-form of preposition be- (in/with/by); Job 9:30 'with snow-water', 16:4 'with words', 19:16 'with mouth', 20:23 'in his belly', 37:8, 38:16, 40:13, Ps 11:2 'in darkness', 18.
Moabite offering-height on exodus-route (Num 21:19,20; 22:41; Josh 13:17). English convention: Bamoth. 'Heights'; family with H1116 bamah 'high-place' (already assigned).
Root bnh (build, H1129). Ben is the built-one in the lineage; female parallel bat (H1323).
Aramaic-coloured variant of ben (son) in the Chronicles-genealogies, related to H1121a ben (son); main-form occurs in 1Chr 15:18, 2Chr 5:2 and similar register-passages.
Proper noun, Levi-singer ('son-of-Asaph'); 1Chr 15:18; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ben.

Aramaic-cognate of-Hebrew-H1121a ben (son) distinguished by Aramaic-language-form in-Daniel-and-Ezra (Dan 3:25 fiery-furnace-rescue-witness 'lo I-see four-men-loose walking in-the-midst-of-the-fire').
Aramaic verb: erect (temple, wall); parallel to Hebrew banah; concordantly 'build-aramaic'.
Solomon-officer 1Kgs 4:11 district-leader with Taphath-Solomon-daughter; son-of-Abinadab.
Proper noun ('son-of-my-sorrow') Rachel's name for Benjamin; Gen 35:18; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ben-oni.
Solomon-officer 1Kgs 4:13 district-leader in Ramoth-Gilead; son-of-Geber.
Solomon-officer 1Kgs 4:9 district-leader; compound proper-noun son-of-Deker.
Root bnh. Stem-family: bayit (house, H1004b), ben (son, H1121a). 'Build' is kernel-activity.
Proper noun ('son-of-Hadad'); title of Aramean kings of Damascus; concordantly transliterated.
Post-exilic Levites and family-heads (Ezra 8:33; 10:30,38; Neh 3:24; 7:15; 10:10; 12:8). 'Building'. English convention: Binnui.
Proper noun, son of Ishi-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:20; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ben-zoheth.
Solomon-officer 1Kgs 4:8 Ephraim-hill-country; compound proper-noun son-of-Hur.
Proper noun, Jehoshaphat's prince for teaching; 2Chr 17:7; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ben-hail.
Proper noun, son of Shimon-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:20; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ben-hanan.
Solomon-officer 1Kgs 4:10 Aruboth-district; compound proper-noun son-of-Hesed.
Proper noun; various Levites and returnees from exile (Ezra, Nehemiah); concordantly transliterated.
Bunni-Levite-Nehemiah-assembly and Bunni-sealer-covenant-renewal and Bunni-Levite-post-exile-house (Neh 9:4; 10:16; 11:15). English convention: Bunni. 'My-builder' or 'built' (family with banah).
Proper noun, Dan-city ('sons-of-the-lightning'); Josh 19:45; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Bene-berak.
Building-piece west-temple; Eze 41:13.
Proper noun ('YHWH-built'); chief of David's bodyguard; concordantly transliterated.
Num-they-departed-from-Moseroth-and-encamped-in-Bene-Jaakan and Num-they-departed-from-Bene-Jaakan-and-encamped-in-Hor-haggidgad (Num 33:31,32). Hyphenated.
1S-a-man-the-champion-from-the-camp-of-the-Philistines and 1S-behold-the-Philistine-champion-whose-name-was-Goliath (1S 17:4,23). Hyphenated.
Proper noun. 'Son-of-the-right-hand'. English convention Benjamin.
Gentilic-designation 'son-of-the-right-hand-tribe'; Saul and later Mordecai (1Sam 9:1,21; 2Sam 16:11; 19:17; 20:1; 1Kgs 2:8; Ps 7:1; Esth 2:5). Derivative of H1144 Binyamin.
Eze-building-on-southside and Eze-construction-broad-five-cubits and Eze-building-separated-place (Eze 40:5; 41:12,15; 42:1,5,10). Hyphenated.
Aramaic form of build-noun; Ezra 5:4.
Proper noun, Levi-signatory of covenant Nehemiah; Neh 10:13; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Beninu.
Aramaic into-fury-kindle (Dan 2:12 king-Nebuchadnezzar); cognate uncertain.
1Chr-and-Moza-begat-Binea-Rephaiah-was-his-son and 1Chr-and-Moza-begat-Binea-and-Rephaiah-was-his-son (1Chr 8:37; 9:43 par). Hyphenated.
Proper noun ('son-of-my-people') son of Lot; Gen 19:38; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ben-ammi.
Father of Meshullam-wall-builder Neh 3:6; theophoric proper noun (in-counsel-Yah).
Head of a Nethinim-family in the return-list - Ezra 2:49, Nehemiah 7:52; disambiguated from H1209 Besai (Joab-son).
Wicked-shakes unripe-grape like vine; Job 15:33.
Unripe-fruit as fathers-sin-image (Isa 18:5; Jer 31:29,30; Eze 18:2; Job 15:33). Hyphenated.
Aramaic verb 'seek/request' in Daniel and Ezra (Ezra 7:14; Dan 2:13,16,18,23,49; 4:33; 6:4,7,12,13; 7:16). Concordantly linked via '-aramaic' to Hebrew H1245 baqash.
Preposition. Through-for, in-favour-of, via. 'On-behalf-of' preserves the mediation-intent; 'for' is too generic.
Thoroughly-investigate or boil-up-bubble (Isa 21:12; 30:13; 64:1,2; Obad 1:6). Hyphenated to distinguish the inquire-search-aspect from H1875 darash 'inquire' and H2713 chaqar 'search-out'.
Aramaic word for petition or supplication - in Daniel 6:7 (whoever shall ask a petition of any god or man for thirty days) and Daniel 6:13 (Daniel prays his prayer); from beah (ask, seek).
Father of prophet-seer-for-hire Balaam (Num 22:5, 24:3,15, 31:8 killed-with-Midianites, Deut 23:5, Josh 13:22, 24:9, Mic 6:5); also father of Bela, first king.
The terrors which God's arrows cause in Job - Job 6:4 (the terrors of God set themselves in array against me) and Psalm 88:17 (Your terrors render me speechless); from H1204 baath (terrify).
Proper noun; husband of Ruth, ancestor of David, also temple-pillar; concordantly transliterated.
Deut-but-Jeshurun-grew-fat-and-kicked and 1S-why-do-you-kick-at-my-sacrifice-and-my-offering-which-I-commanded-in-my-habitation (Deut 32:15; 1S 2:29). Hyphenated.
Hapax Job 30:24 on-rubble-heap-not-stretch-out-hand; from H1165 baah inquire-dig.
Pack-livestock in household or caravan (Gen 45:17; Ex 22:4; Num 20:4,8,11; Ps 78:48). Hyphenated; distinguishes transport-or-work-cattle from H929 behemah 'beast' (animal-general).
Qal: be husband, become master over; the hyphenated English marks position (distinguished from baal noun 'lord' and Baal pn).
Function-term: owner/responsible-one; the hyphenated English preserves authority + ownership; person-name Baal = H1168a.
Proper noun; god of Canaan; concordantly transliterated because proper-nouns are not translated.

Reubenite family-ancestor and Benjamite-Gibeonite (1Chr 5:5; 8:30; 9:36). English convention: Baal-person. Distinguished from homonym H1168a baal 'Baal-god' (already assigned); family with H1167 baal.
Aramaic baal/lord in title 'master-of-decree'; Ezra 4:8.
Judg-the-children-of-Israel-set-up-Baal-Berith-as-their-god and Judg-out-of-the-house-of-Baal-Berith (Judg 8:33; 9:4). Hyphenated.
Baal-Gad-valley-northern-border-Lebanon and Joshua-border-marker (Josh 11:17; 12:7; 13:5). English convention: Baal-Gad. 'Lord-of-fortune' (Canaanite-Gad-deity-toponym).
Female-owner or ruler-woman (1Sam 28:7 twice; Nah 3:4; Isa 47:7). Hyphenated to distinguish the mistress-owner-aspect from H1404 geveret 'mistress' (already assigned); family with H1167 ba'al.
Kiriath-Jearim also called Baalah (Josh 15:9,10,11,29; 1Chr 13:6). English convention: Baalah. 'Mistress'. Distinguished from homonym H1172 ba'alah 'mistress-woman'.
Proper noun, Solomon-vineyard-location; Song 8:11; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Baal-hamon.
Proper noun, Judah-city south; Josh 15:24; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Bealoth.
Philistine Ekron-god whom Ahaziah consults (2Kgs 1:2,3,6,16). English convention: Baal-Zebub. Compound 'lord-of-flies'; family with H2070 zevuv 'fly'.
Edom-king and David's court-keeper (Gen 36:38,39; 1Chr 1:49,50; 27:28). Compound 'Baal-is-gracious'.
Proper noun, place where Absalom killed Amnon; 2Sam 13:23; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Baal-Hazor.
Judg-the-Hivites-dwelling-on-mount-Lebanon-from-mount-Baal-Hermon and 1Chr-they-multiplied-from-Bashan-to-Baal-Hermon (Judg 3:3; 1Chr 5:23). Hyphenated.
Proper-noun-title ('my-master') forbidden for YHWH; Hos 2:16; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Baali.
Proper noun, David's-son Jerusalem-born variant Eliada; 1Chr 14:7; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Beeliada.
Proper noun, Benjamite David's-warrior Ziklag; 1Chr 12:5; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Bealiah.
Proper noun ('Judah-burghers') where David fetched the ark; 2Sam 6:2; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Baale-Judah.
Proper noun, Ammonite king who sent Ishmael-against-Gedaliah; Jer 40:14; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Baalis.
Baal-Meon-city in Reuben-territory and Moab-lament (Num 32:38; 1Chr 5:8; Eze 25:9). English convention: Baal-Meon. 'Lord-of-dwelling' (Canaanite-toponym-combination).
Moabite idol with whose cult Israel committed harlotry (Num 25:3,5; Deut 4:3; Ps 106:28; Hos 9:10). English convention: Baal-Peor; compound with H1168 Baal.
Place-name of David's breakthrough against the Philistines (2Sam 5:20 twice; 1Chr 14:11 twice; Isa 28:21). Compound 'Baal-of-breakings'; family with H6555 parats 'break-through'.
Baal-Zephon-toponym at Pi-hahiroth and Egyptian-border (Ex 14:2,9; Num 33:7). English convention: Baal-Zephon. 'Lord-of-the-North' (Canaanite-storm-god-toponym).
Proper noun, place of origin of firstfruit-loaves Elisha; 2Kgs 4:42; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Baal-Shalishah.
Baalath-city in Dan-territory and rebuilt-by-Solomon (Josh 19:44; 1Kgs 9:18; 2Chr 8:6). English convention: Baalath. 'Female-Baal-goddess' or 'mistress-city'.
Proper noun ('mistress-of-the-well') Simeon-city; Josh 19:8; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Baalath-Beer.
Proper noun ('palm-lord') battle-place Benjamin-war; Judg 20:33; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Baal-Tamar.
Proper noun, place of Gad-inheritance; Num 32:3; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Beon.
Proper noun, Solomon-officer 1Kgs 4 and David's-warrior 2Sam 4.
Different persons: murderer of Ish-bosheth, mighty man of David, overseer of Solomon (2Sam 4:2,5,6,9; 23:29; 1Kgs 4:12,16; 1Chr 11:30; Ezra 2:2; Neh 3:4; 7:7; 10:28). English convention: Baanah.
Root b'r. 'Burn' preserves the fire-active; 'consume-by-fire' is transitive splinter.
Second homonym distinguished from ba'ar-I (burn, H1197a); Qal/Piel/Hiphil: by-cattle-or-fire-consume-bare distinguished from ra'ah-I (pasture, H7462a) by exhausting-consumption-aspect (Ex 22:4 etc.).
Beast-like illiterate man (Ps 49:11; 73:22; 92:7; 94:8; Prov 12:1; 30:2). Hyphenated to distinguish the brutish-stupid-aspect from H3684 kesil 'fool' and H5036 naval 'fool-godless'.
Proper noun, wife of Shaharaim whom he sent away; 1Chr 8:8; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Baara.
Burn-eruption in grain; Ex 22:6.
Proper noun; king of the Northern Kingdom; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, Gershon-Levi-genealogy descendant Asaph; 1Chr 6:40; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Baaseiah.
Proper noun, Levi-city of Manasseh; Josh 21:27; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Beeshterah.
Piel: suddenly terrify (nightly anxiety, evil spirit upon Saul); the hyphenated English marks the sudden-onset.
Bewilderment-instead-of-peace; Jer 8:15.
Feet-Jeremiah-stuck-in-mire-mud-pit; Jer 38:22.
Marshy salt-lands and water-pool (Job 8:11; 40:21; Eze 47:11). Hyphenated to distinguish the marsh-pool-aspect from H98 agam 'pool-marsh' and H4325 mayim 'water' (already assigned).
Bashan's-oak-forest impregnable-perished; Zech 11:2.

Bezai-temple-servants-family-head-returnees-Zerubbabel-and-Ezra-and-Nehemiah-lists (Ezra 2:49; Neh 7:52; 10:19). English convention: Bezai. 'Conqueror' or 'treader' (etymology-uncertain-possibly-family-with batsa).
Plucking and pressing grapes as annual harvest-festival (Lev 26:5; Judg 8:2; Isa 24:13; 32:10; Jer 48:32; 49:9; Mic 7:1; Zech 11:2). Hyphenated to mark pluck-season; family with H1219 batsar.
Egyptian vegetable-craving; Num 11:5.

Theophoric-name 'in shadow-of-El' - chief-craftsman of-the-tribe-Judah for Tabernacle-making (Ex 31:2 'I-have-called-by-name Bezalel son-of-Uri son-of-Hur of-tribe-Judah; I-have-filled-him-with-Spirit').
Head of a Nethinim-family in the return-list - Ezra 2:52, Nehemiah 7:54.
Qal/Piel: cut-off for oneself, practise rapacity (Proverbs, Ezekiel); the hyphenated English marks motive.
From √batsa (cut-off/take-spoil); unjust profit, gain; concordantly 'gain'.
Deut-your-clothing-did-not-grow-old-on-you and Neh-and-the-feet-of-them-did-not-swell and Ex-and-the-people-took-their-dough-before-it-was-leavened (Deut 8:4; Neh 9:21; Ex 12:34 cf). Hyphenated.
Unbaked dough-mass for bread (Ex 12:34,39; 2Sam 13:8; Jer 7:18; Hos 7:4). Hyphenated to distinguish the kneading-mass-aspect from H3888 lush 'dough-knead' (verb).
Josh-Lachish-Bozkath-Eglon and 2K-the-name-of-his-mother-was-Jedidah-the-daughter-of-Adaiah-of-Bozkath (Josh 15:39; 2K 22:1). Hyphenated.
Qal: harvest grapes, cut off; Niphal: be inaccessible (walls, fortress); the hyphenated English covers both semantic axes.
The gold-ore or precious metal in raw form - Job 22:24 (lay your gold to dust) and 36:19 (not gold nor all the strong-resources); to be distinguished from refined gold.
Reubenite city-of-refuge in plateau (Deut 4:43; Josh 20:8; 21:36; 1Chr 6:63,78). English convention: Bezer. 'Inaccessible-stronghold-city'.
Precious-ore-wealth not-helps; Job 36:19.
God-shall-gather-Israel as-sheep-in-fold; Mic 2:12.
Capital/fortified-city in Edom (Gen 36:33; 1Chr 1:44; Isa 34:6; 63:1; Jer 48:24; 49:13,22; Amos 1:12; Mic 2:12). From batsar 'make-impregnable'. English convention: Bozrah.
Prisoners-return-to-stronghold-citadel; Zech 9:12.
Tree-by-water-bears-fruit even in drought-year; Jer 17:8.
Head of a Nethinim-family in the return-list, name means flask/jug - Ezra 2:51, Nehemiah 7:53.
Jeroboam's-wife-flask-honey-for-prophet and Jeremiah's-symbolic-jar-breaking (1Kgs 14:3; Jer 19:1,10). Hyphenated.
Bakbukiah-Levite-second-in-rank-Nehemiah and Bakbukiah-gatekeeper-temple-gates and Bakbukiah-ancestor-priestly-line (Neh 11:17; 12:9,25). English convention: Bakbukiah.
Proper noun, Levi tribe-head post-exile; 1Chr 9:15; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Bakbakkar.
Aaronite priest and Danite prince (Num 34:22; 1Chr 5:31; 6:36; Ezra 7:4). English convention: Bukki. 'My-pouring-out'.
One of the sons of Heman, levitical temple-musician and head of the sixth division - 1Chronicles 25:4, 25:13.
Crack or breach in wall - in Isaiah 22:9 (the breaches of the city of David you saw) and Amos 6:11 (He shall smite the great house with breaches); from H1234 baqa (split).
Qal: cut through, break open (rock, sea, egg); concordantly 'split'.
Gen-a-beka-half-shekel-golden-nose-ring and Ex-beka-per-head-half-holy-shekel-cross-offering-money (Gen 24:22; Ex 38:26). Hyphenated.
Aramaic parallel to biqah; plain-of-Dura; Dan 3:1.
From √baqa (split); valley between mountains; the hyphenated English marks geography.
First-sense baqaq; Israel-spreading-vine becomes-emptying; Hos 10:1.
Empty-pour or strip-bare of city or heart (Isa 19:3; 24:1,3; Jer 19:7; 51:2; Nah 2:3). Hyphenated to distinguish the emptying-strip-aspect from H7324 ruq 'pour-out'.
Carefully examine, inspect cattle or priestly-examination (Lev 13:36; 27:33; 2Kgs 16:15; Ps 27:4; Prov 20:25; Eze 34:11,12). Hyphenated; distinguishes inspection-inquiry from homonym H1241 baqar.
Investigate-in-empire-archives-chronicles and in-treasury-of-Babel-search and king-decree-by-law-investigate (Ezra 4:15,19; 5:17; 6:1; 7:14). Hyphenated.
Unique lexeme. Collective for cattle. 'Cattle' covers the large-livestock; distinguished from tson (small-livestock, H6629).
Root bqr (inquire, H1239). Morning as time-of-discernment (light/dark). 'Morning' standard.
Shepherd-seeks-his-sheep on-the-day; Eze 34:12.
Discipline-investigation (not death-penalty); Lev 19:20.
Root bqsh. Piel-intensively seek. 'Seek' is kernel.

What-is-asked/requested; petition especially in Esther and post-exile (Ezra 7:6; Esth 5:3,6,7,8; 7:2,3; 9:12). Hyphenated; distinguishes formal-court-petition from H8467 techinnah supplication and H8605.
Aramaic 'son-of' in genealogies and royal-title (Ezra 5:1,2; 6:14; Ps 2:12 (?); Dan 3:25; 5:22; 7:13). Hyphenated to preserve distinction from homonym H1247b 'field-aramaic'; family with H1121.

Honorific-use 'son' with king and wisdom-address (Ps 2:12; Prov 31:2 three times). Hyphenated to distinguish the royal-son-noble-aspect from homonyms H1247 bar-Aram-II 'son-aramaic' (already assigned).
Moral-ritual purity of heart or deed (Job 11:4; 33:9; Ps 24:4; 73:1; Prov 14:4; Song 6:9,10). Hyphenated to preserve inward-purity; family with H1305 barar 'purify'.
Open-field grain (Gen 41-42, Joseph's stores), corn on the threshing-floor; the hyphenated English distinguishes from bar II 'son-aramaic' and III 'pure'.
Second-sense bar; mountain-goat-bears young in-field; Job 39:4.
Aramaic-equivalent for outside-field (Dan 2:38; 4:9,12,20,22,29,30). Hyphenated to mark the Aramaic-parallel; distinguished from Hebrew H7704 sadeh 'field'.
Moral pure-state of hands or heart (2Sam 22:21,25; Ps 18:21,25; Job 22:30). Hyphenated to distinguish the innocence-purity-aspect from H2890 tohar 'cleanness' and H5355 naqi 'innocent'.
The cleanness of hands by which God recompenses - Psalm 18:21 (He has rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands), 2Samuel 22:21, Job 22:30; from H1249 bar (pure-clean).
Qal: unique divine creating (only God as subject); distinguished from yatsar (form) and asah (make); concordantly 'create'.
Second-sense bara; Eli's sons gorge-themselves with sacrifice-meat; 1Sam 2:29.
Proper noun, Babylonian king after Hezekiah's-recovery; 2Kgs 20:12; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Berodach-baladan.
Proper noun, Benjamin-son Shimei; 1Chr 8:21; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Beraiah.
Fatted birds Solomon's-table; 1Kgs 4:23.
Qal; hail-comes-down on forest-trees; Isa 32:19.
Ice-precipitation from storm, plague in Egypt; concordantly 'hail'.
Gen-spring-Lahai-Roi-between-Kadesh-and-Bered and 1Chr-Bered-as-son-Ephraim (Gen 16:14; 1Chr 7:20). Hyphenated.
Pepper-salt colour-pattern of Laban-flock (Gen 31:10,12; Zech 6:3,6). Hyphenated to distinguish the spotted-spotted-aspect from H5348 naqod 'speckled' (already assigned) and H5921 talu 'spotted'.
Mourn-meal or strength-food consume (2Sam 3:35; 12:17; 13:5,6,10; Lam 4:10). Hyphenated to preserve the comfort-food-aspect; family with H1279 biryah 'food-dish'.
Proper noun ('blessed'); scribe of Jeremiah; concordantly transliterated.
Multi-coloured-cloth in Tyre-trade; Eze 27:24.
Conifer of Lebanon, used for temple-construction; the hyphenated English marks species.
Cedar-beams cypress-gallery for bridal-army; Song 1:17.
Enemies-gave-gall-for-food; Ps 69:21.
First-sense Berothah; northern border-place Israel; Eze 47:16; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Berothah.
Second-sense Berothai; Aramean place David-spoils; 2Sam 8:8; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Berothai.
1Chr-and-Eber-and-Mishal-and-Shomer-and-Hotham-and-the-sons-of-Helem-his-brother-Zophah-and-Imna-and-Shelesh-and-Amal-Birzaith-Helem (1Chr 7:31). Hyphenated.
Metal; concordantly 'iron' (material, not tool).

Gileadite from-Rogelim who-fed David's-fugitive-company at-Jordan-crossing (2Sam 17:27-29 David-at-Mahanaim, 19:32-40 Barzillai's-elderly-decline-of-honour, 1Kgs 2:7 David's-deathbed-charge-Solomon-honour).
Qal: run away from, escape; concordantly 'flee-away' (distinguished from nus = flee).
Patronym-clan David's-warrior Azmaveth; 2Sam 23:31; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Barhumite.
Fat-sheep oppress-the-lean; Eze 34:20.
Proper noun, Asher tribe-head son of Zophah (not H1276 tribe-Beri); 1Chr 7:36; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Beri.
Proper noun, people in Abel-region; 2Sam 20:14; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Beri.
From √bara (be-thick); fat and healthy (fat cows of Pharaoh, fat flock); concordantly 'well-fleshed'.
Something-completely-new; earth swallows up Korah; Num 16:30.
Amnon-special-food-from-Tamar-asks (2Sam 13:5,7,10; Lam 4:10). Hyphenated.
Cross-beam that bars gate or door; concordantly 'bar'.
Leviathan-fleeing-twisting-serpent and Isa-leviathan-fleeing-serpent and Jer-Babel-flee-as-serpent (Job 26:13; Isa 27:1; 43:14). Hyphenated.
Proper noun, son of Shemaiah-David-branch; 1Chr 3:22; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Bariah.
Son of Asher, grandson of Jacob (Gen 46:17, Num 26:44-45, 1Chr 7:30-31); son of Ephraim (1Chr 7:23); Levitical main-line (1Chr 23:10-11); Benjamite (1Chr 8:13-16); concordantly transliterated.
Patronym-clan son of Asher; Num 26:44; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Beriite.
Unique lexeme. Etymology contested (possibly brh = cut). Legally binding agreement. 'Covenant' standard.
Proper noun, Shechem-deity ('covenant-El'); Judg 9:46; concordantly transliterated. English convention: El-berith.

Lye or potash as detergent - in Jeremiah 2:22 (though you wash yourself with lye and use much soap) and Malachi 3:2 (He is like the refiner's fire and like the fullers' soap); alkaline cleaning agent.
Root brk. Piel-directed action of speaking-prosperity. Derived berakhah (blessing, H1293). 'Bless' is kernel-meaning.
Aramaic-equivalent for kneeling-blessing of God (Dan 2:19,20; 3:28; 4:31; 6:11). Hyphenated to mark the Aramaic-parallel; family with H1288 barakh 'bless' (Hebrew).
Body-part, seat of bowing and blessing-gesture; concordantly 'knee'.
Aramaic parallel to berek; Daniel-on-knees three-times-daily; Dan 6:10.
The father of the young wise-man Elihu of the family Buzi of Aram - Job 32:2, 32:6; name means 'God has blessed'.
From √barach (kneel/bless); the blessing as gift or utterance; concordantly 'blessing'.
Beracah-valley-where-Jehoshaphat-people-blessed-YHWH-after-victory-Moab-Ammon-Edom (2Chr 20:26 twice). English convention: Beracah-valley. Distinguished from H1293 berakhah 'blessing'.
Walled pond (Siloam, Bethesda, Gibeon); the hyphenated English marks function (distinguished from berachah 'blessing').
Various Levites and Zerubbabel-contemporary (1Chr 3:20; 6:24,39; 9:16; 15:17,23; 2Chr 28:12; Neh 3:4,30; 6:18; Zech 1:1,7). 'YHWH-blesses'. English convention: Berekiah.
Aramaic-contrast in vision or decree (Ezra 5:13; Dan 2:28; 4:12,20,23; 5:17; 7:28). Hyphenated to distinguish the but-however-aspect from H61 aval 'verily' (already assigned); Aramaic cognate.
Proper noun, king of Sodom; Gen 14:2; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Bera.
Qal-imperative; cast-lightning and scatter enemies; Ps 144:6.
2S-He-sent-arrows-and-scattered-them-lightnings-and-discomfited-them and Ps-He-sent-out-his-arrows-and-scattered-them-and-many-lightnings-and-discomfited-them (2S 22:15; Ps 18:15). Hyphenated.
Flashing heaven-spark, glance of sword; concordantly 'lightning' (distinguished from Baraq-pn).
